listenings.text: And here she is, the surfer everybody has been talking about this season. She made her debut in twenty twenty-two, when she was fourteen, and since then she has entered nineteen events. She has won two titles, both of them last year, and she has already made three finals so far this season. One detail for you: she has never surfed this reef in a competition. Never. So whatever happens in the next thirty minutes, it is her first time out there with a jersey on.

People always ask about the background. It was swimming, actually. I swam competitively until I was eleven and then I found a board and that was it. I made my debut at fifteen and I competed for twelve years. The highlight was the national title in twenty nineteen, no question about it. I retired in twenty twenty-two, because of the shoulder, and honestly it was the right moment. I coach juniors now, and I have not missed the travelling once.

reading.rtitle: Athlete profile: from the skatepark to the tour
paras: Her background is skateboarding. She started surfing at eleven, and she made her debut in a junior event in 2022, when she was fourteen. She finished last in that first heat.
Since then she has entered nineteen events. She has won two titles and she has made the semifinal eight times. This season she has made three finals so far, and the season is not over.
The highlight of her career is easy to name, because everybody names the same wave: she scored a nine point eight last April, on a day when nobody else got past a seven.

There is one thing she has never done. She has never surfed a reef in a competition. Her home spot is a beach break, and every event she has entered so far has been on sand. That changes this weekend.
